children: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates:

The Nifty continues to move higher propelled by the FIIs, but that move will be put to test today as results from Nvidia have triggered a rebound on Wall Street's futures, and could well rub-off on the Asian AI markets as well. Supply emerged at 25,500 levels during the weekly expiry session and that is now the level to watch on the upside.

On the downside, the 25,250 - 25,200 level could provide some support to the Nifty. The Nifty bank scaled new peaks on Tuesday and also closed near the day's high, which could give the bulls some comfort.

The record high level of 62,442 will be the one to cross for the bulls, while on the downside, 62,000 - 61,500 levels will be a zone that the bulls would not want to break below. In case the AI trade does rebound, Indian IT will be in focus, so will be the AI enablers / infrastructure providers such as the GE Vernova T&D's and its peers.
The supply of paper continues with one IPO opening for subscription today and a big IIFL Finance block deal lined up in store. Also keep an eye on SpiceJet ahead of its board meet to raise funds.

title: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates: GIFT Nifty extends losses to 110 points
